goals.objective: Implement the approved chat-reliability-streaming work plan as one coordinated delivery: preserve existing runtime data; fix new-session persistence errors; deliver genuine bounded SSE streaming with cancellation-safe UI; and add the requested engineering decision-evidence guidance, with automated UI and load verification.

successCriteria.scenario: Run deterministic fresh and restarted Unicode session flows against a fake provider; verify complete SSE output, persisted messages, checkpointer/session deletion behavior, and no internal error disclosure.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/chat-reliability-streaming/criterion-C001-persistence-http.txt containing HTTP/SSE transcript plus restart/state assertions at the captured git tree.

successCriteria.scenario: Run a real local browser flow and deterministic delayed-provider tests proving token-before-completion, fragmented SSE parsing, Stop/pagehide/session-switch cancellation, no cross-session UI update, 409 same-session conflict, and 503 Retry-After capacity response.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/chat-reliability-streaming/criterion-C002-browser-load.md with browser screenshot/action log, HTTP headers, and ten-session benchmark metrics at the captured git tree.

successCriteria.scenario: Inspect the final diff and canonical guidance to confirm decision-evidence policy is present, dirty user hunks are preserved, no automatic data deletion or raw secret/traceback exposure exists, and required full quality gates pass.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/evidence/chat-reliability-streaming/criterion-C003-scope-quality.md with diff audit, command transcripts, and cleanup receipts at the captured git tree.
